mapper.select: SELECT eating_id, date, name, protein, fat, carbo FROM eatings WHERE eating_id = #{eatingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eatings(eating_id, date, user_id, name, calories, protein, fat, carbo, created_at, updated_at) VALUES( #{eatingId}, #{date}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{calories}, #{protein}, #{fat}, #{carbo}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (eating_id) DO UPDATE SET date=EXCLUDED.date, name=EXCLUDED.name, calories=EXCLUDED.calories, protein=EXCLUDED.protein, fat=EXCLUDED.fat, carbo=EXCLUDED.carbo, updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
